assets.mode: Redraw original icon enclosed in prismatic optical glass
assets.prompt: Redraw the referenced object as a premium 3D optical-glass icon. The reference identifies the object only; completely replace its blue ceramic treatment. A small monochrome silver-and-pearl object is suspended INSIDE a thick, clear, softly rounded glass cube, visibly enclosed behind the front glass surface, not printed onto it. The cube is a compact polished optical crystal with very large smooth corner radii and subtle curved bevels, not a sharp box; front three-quarter view with a modest visible top and right side, no stand. Neutral grayscale and clear glass dominate 90 percent of the image. The internal object has pearl-white surfaces, smoky silver details and charcoal-gray recessed areas for readability. Glass is genuinely transparent, with physically believable thickness, refraction, internal reflection and restrained bright white highlights. Where light passes through the glass bevels, create narrow subtle prism-dispersion bands of red, orange, yellow, green, cyan and violet, especially along the upper-right and lower-left edges. This rainbow belongs only to refracted light on the glass, never to the body of the inner object. Elegant optical prism aesthetic, not rainbow plastic, not holographic painted metal, no neon glow or colored background. Soft neutral studio lighting, clear silhouette readable at 64px, cinematic photoreal 3D product render. Square image; centered cube occupies about 82 percent of the canvas, entirely visible with generous transparent margins. Genuine transparent alpha background outside the glass, no background plane, cast shadow, pedestal, floor, floating decorations, lettering, logos or watermark. The enclosed object is a recognizable miniature globe with softly raised silver continent silhouettes on a pearl-white sphere and one slim dark-silver meridian ring. It floats centrally with a small clear gap from the glass enclosure on all sides. Preserve the globe's simple recognizable spherical shape and Asian-facing view from the reference.
